coverage.reason: This coordinated feature connects current-Core NPC population, map subscriptions, private scouting, authoritative army/rally departure and arrival settlement, the playable Crown wallet, permanent stamina and UI. New rule tests cover all 100 levels, 2–20 pool shares, item boundaries, exact combat ties, large armies, recovery and Hero XP caps. Population emulators cover all 25 Core maps, all current New Lands and future generated closed-admission maps; the terrain validator checks all 81 actual layouts and the generated seasonal clearance. Real callable combat tests cover neutral shields, duplicate launch/settlement, scout privacy, failed defenders, ordered arrivals, replacement identity, recalls, invalid-target refunds, two-member boss rallies, individual XP caps and indirect level-up rewards. Stamina and actual payment/pickup/cosmetic transaction tests cover balance boundaries, UTC rollover, permanent profile-independent state, stale quotes, idempotency and concurrent spending/credits. Existing travel, rally, forecast, gear, report and progression suites protect these shared dependencies. Browser checks at desktop and both landscape sizes exercise keyboard/focus, exact refill review, preserved real attack drafts, explicit sending, stale-spawn rejection, search/intel/reports/readiness, wider HUD collision bounds and existing Crown purchase controls. Production artifact validation and the normal prepare-pr build cover scripts, shared rules, artwork, service-worker references and release hashes. Runner registration requires the workflow/push-protection tests. No unrelated/full regression suites are selected. NPC scout reports also enter through the actual report list, retain their spawn key during expiry ticks, and reuse report navigation and timing layout. Asset checks cap the five new shell files at 36 KiB and two lazy sprites at 112 KiB total; the measured 19,993-byte installation overage is bounded by a 24 KiB allowance, preserving offline dependencies and all other performance limits. The revised NPC artwork is checked beside current city art at desktop and landscape-mobile sizes for south-facing perspective, transparent ground edges, map-scale readability and the existing sprite byte limits. The simplified refill review and real Shop round trip cover live-only catalog availability, disabled/test-only/offline checkout, zero/below/exact refill-price boundaries, no automatic spending, exact draft DOM/handler preservation, rally context, focus restoration and all three viewports. Shop presentation and shared modal lifecycle validators cover the new return interception. Shop loading uses the existing optional resource loader, with canceled-load and sign-out checks. Its measured 16.3 KiB source now has a bounded 17 KiB limit for the new return path; the installation-cache and NPC-shell budgets remain unchanged. Crown checkout layout comparisons pin the existing desktop/full and mobile/reduced animation settings so delayed automatic resize adaptation cannot change the close button reference frame between tabs; exact layout assertions remain intact. Proportional refill pricing covers all 101 stamina values, whole-Crown rounding, price-boundary regeneration, server-calculated debits and receipts, old-version/forged/stale quotes, exact-price affordability below 30 Crowns, and concurrent cosmetic, pickup and verified payment transactions. Browser tests verify 9-Crown and 1-Crown refills, the computed Shop shortfall, receipt confirmation and 28-Crown draft restoration at all three viewports. Persistent stamina format and the once-per-UTC-day allowance remain unchanged. The compact 104×52px stamina card and yellow bar reuse the existing three-viewport HUD, touch-target, keyboard, focus and refill-flow checks, with fresh visual review of the main HUD.

Record explicitly approved gameplay, the paid Crown exception, HUD behavior, balance budgets and current-realm gated release/monitoring instructions. Documentation describes the feature tested above and grants no production authorization.
